list_source: Official trophy list as published by PlayStation, reported 18 Nov 2026 from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements (see sources on each trophy).

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are all unlocked, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work through the story, the side strands, the collectibles and the activity grinds in any order you like, and keep an eye on the tracker in this app to see what is left. Expect roughly 200 hours in total, and remember that using cheats disables trophies, so leave cheats alone until the platinum is yours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this trophy is unmissable and unlocks naturally as you play the first story beats. Follow the on-screen prompts through the fishing tutorial, which teaches the casting and reeling mechanics you will use later in the game. Just finish the mission and the trophy pops at the results screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 1 in order; the trophy unlocks when the final mission of the chapter ends. There is no way to miss it, and no optional objective is required, so just keep following the story markers around Vice City and Leonida. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at the balcony spot for the Positive Mental Attitude trophy, because that spot is gone afterwards.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 2's missions and the trophy will pop at the end of the chapter's final mission. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter as a safety net, even though the story trophies themselves cannot be missed. Use the downtime between missions to knock out nearby activities and collectibles so the later cleanup is shorter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete the last mission of Chapter 3 and this trophy unlocks automatically. Chapter 3 opens up more of Vice City, so take the chance to explore new districts and unlock fast-travel options while the story carries you around the map. Nothing here is missable, so play at your own pace.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Work through Chapter 4's mission chain to its conclusion and the trophy pops when the final mission wraps up. By this point the story is throwing bigger set-pieces at you, so stock up on armour and ammo before the heavier shootouts. As always, keep a manual save at the chapter start in case you ever need to revisit it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission and this gold trophy unlocks. Before you start it, make a manual save — there is no mission replay reported, so a pre-finale save is your only way back to try a different approach or mop up anything you left behind. Go in fully stocked with weapons, armour and snacks, then follow the mission objectives to the end.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission, so simply play it when it appears in your mission list and finish it to unlock the trophy. Watch the mission briefing and follow the waypoint prompts; the objectives are straightforward and there is no hidden requirement. If you fail a section, the checkpoint restart puts you right back in.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a major story heist mission; complete it and the trophy is yours. Heists usually involve a setup phase followed by the main job, so pay attention to the planning steps and pick the approach that suits your play style. Bring your best weapons and armour, use cover during the firefights, and stick with your crew through the escape.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the Child's Play story mission to completion and the trophy unlocks at the end. Follow the mission markers and the dialogue cues, and use the checkpoint system if a section goes wrong. No optional objective is needed for this one.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission, so start it from your mission list and play it through to the end. Expect a mix of driving and combat, so keep a fast car handy and restock ammo before you begin. The trophy pops as soon as the mission completes.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown takes you to Vice City International Airport, so complete the mission there and the trophy unlocks. Airport missions tend to attract heavy police attention, so plan your escape route before the shooting starts and keep a getaway vehicle nearby. Finish every objective and the trophy pops at mission end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a late story mission with a big combat set-piece, so go in prepared with full armour, your strongest rifles and plenty of ammo. Use cover, move between objectives methodically, and let your allies draw fire when you can. Complete the mission and the trophy unlocks.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion by finishing the story, all side-mission strands, the collectible sets, the activity challenges and the world-exploration requirements. Check the in-game stats screen regularly to see which categories are still short, and use this tracker to tick off the related trophies as you go. This is the last big gold before the platinum, so treat it as your final checklist rather than a separate grind.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, airtime and other driving feats all count toward the total. The counter ticks up naturally as you drive aggressively, but you can speed it up by chaining stunt jumps off ramps and hitting long airtime off the bridges and hills around Vice City. Use a fast, light car or a bike, and keep an eye on the stunt counter in your stats to track progress.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type in the game at least once: racing, fishing, shooting range, bowling, arcade games, drone races and anything else the map offers. You do not need to win or finish well — just start and complete one of each. Open the map and look for the activity icons you have not tried yet, and tick them off one by one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit the shooting range and earn a gold medal in every challenge it offers. Learn each challenge's target pattern before going for gold, use the weapon the challenge specifies, and take your time aiming rather than spraying — accuracy and speed both feed the score. Repeat a challenge as many times as you need; the best medal is what counts.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Find every Top Fun drone race location on the map and win a race at each one. Drone races are about smooth lines through the rings, so cut corners gently, avoid crashing into buildings, and learn each course's layout on a practice run before racing for the win. Winning at the final location pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the key word is different, so repeating the same race does not count twice. Work through the race events scattered around Leonida, from street races in Vice City to off-road events in the countryside. Pick a well-upgraded car for each surface, learn the braking points, and avoid traffic by taking clean lines.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat his catch. Use the fishing mechanics you learned in the opening mission: cast where fish are showing, watch the line tension, and reel steadily without snapping it. Heavier lures and better spots help, so fish in the deeper water around the Leonida coast and keys where the bigger catches live.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine in Vice City, start a game and play it to completion. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you find easiest and see it through to the end screen. Arcades are usually marked on the map, and this is a quick trophy to grab early while you are exploring the city.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's side-mission strand through all of its missions until the final one. Side contacts usually call or text you when the next mission is ready, so keep an eye on your phone and visit Andy's marker when it appears. Finish the last mission in the chain and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work through Kenton's side missions to the end of his strand. His jobs tend to involve the water around Vice City and the keys, so keep a fast boat in mind and be ready for on-water chases. Complete his final mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's full side-mission strand, ending with his final mission. Billy's jobs are bike-heavy, so a good motorcycle and confident riding through Vice City traffic will help. Answer his calls, follow the markers, and finish the last job for the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida — the question-mark encounters you meet while exploring. Each strand is several missions long, so this takes a while; check the map for stranger markers in every region, from Vice City out to the swamps and the keys. Finish the final mission of your eighth strand and the silver pops.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's side-mission strand to its final mission. His work is tied to supply runs around Leonida, so expect driving and delivery objectives with the occasional ambush. Keep a sturdy vehicle ready, complete the last mission, and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's side-mission strand, ending with his final mission. His jobs lean toward the Vice City music and club scene, so expect night-time driving and close-quarters encounters. Answer his calls when they come, follow the strand to the end, and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — this is the one possibly missable trophy in the game. The Chapter 1 balcony spot disappears once the chapter ends, so meditate there before you finish Chapter 1, and visit every other spot as you reach it. Because no mission replay is reported, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission as insurance.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting job and track down the unique animal he wants. Hunting is about patience: move slowly, watch the wind and the animal's trail, and use a scoped rifle for a clean shot from distance. Bring the animal back or complete the hunt objective as Bret asks, and the trophy unlocks.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden all over Leonida, grouped into sets — complete any 3 full sets to earn this silver. Search rooftops, alleyways, shops and scenic spots, and use the in-game collection tracker to see which cards in each set you still need. Prioritise the sets with the fewest cards missing first so you finish three sets as early as possible.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 different locations around Leonida — the in-game photo or check-in style activity that asks you to mark spots. Spread the effort across the whole map rather than grinding one district, and grab spots whenever you pass them during missions and exploration. The counter in your stats shows how many of the 100 you have done.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list — the small objectives that cover driving, combat, exploration and activities. Open the challenge menu, pick the easiest ones first, and let the harder ones fill in naturally as you play. Many challenges overlap with other trophies, so you will already be partway there by the time you finish the story.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops together. Get the wanted level up by committing crimes in a busy area, then break line of sight and hide — alleyways, parking garages and the countryside all work. Stay out of the police search cones until the stars clear, and make sure your partner is still with you when the heat dies down.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level active the whole time — do not let the stars clear between robberies. Pick three shops close together on the same street, hit them one after another, and keep moving so the police cannot corner you. A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the chain much easier.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by getting into them — each new model you drive for the first time counts. Explore car parks, dealerships, the airport, the docks and the countryside to find rare models, and hop into anything you have not driven before. The vehicle log in your stats shows which models you still need.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus during a firefight and take down 5 enemies before it runs out. Set it up by finding a spot with a group of enemies close together — a gang hideout or a police ambush works well — then trigger Combat Focus and pick targets quickly. Headshots drop enemies fastest, so aim high and keep moving between shots.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Head to Vice City International Airport, get onto the airfield, and steal a plane for an unscheduled departure. The runway and hangars are guarded, so expect police attention the moment you cross the fence — go in fast, grab a plane, and get airborne before the response builds up. Once you are in the air and clear of the airport, the trophy pops.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get behind the controls of a Rhino tank and cause some chaos with it. Tanks are heavily guarded, so the usual approach is to build a high wanted level or find one at a military site, then fight your way in. Once you are driving the Rhino, the trophy should pop — drive it around and enjoy the firepower while you are at it.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected — no alarms, no witnesses calling the police. Case the store first, go in when it is quiet, move slowly, and avoid the staff's line of sight while you grab the goods. If you are spotted, leave and try again later; a clean, patient run is what this trophy wants.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape cleanly each time. Vault jobs are the biggest robberies in the game, so plan each one: scout the bank, bring your partner, and have a fast getaway car waiting outside. After cracking the vault, get out fast and lose the wanted level before the next job — all five escapes count toward the silver.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the roads of Leonida, rob it, and escape. The classic approach is to ram it or block it with your car, then crack it open while the guards react — or wait until it stops at a delivery point. Once you have the cash, break away fast and lose the wanted level to finish the job.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida until the whole map is revealed. Drive, fly or sail into each corner of the state — the beaches and keys, the swamps, the farmland, the small towns and every district of Vice City. The map fills in as you travel, so a long road trip across the state is the fastest way to finish this one.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida — one per gang. Gang operations are marked as you explore and through story contacts, and each one is a small raid: fight through the guards, grab the stash, and get out. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit so you do not repeat one by mistake.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City, find a beachfront bar, and order a cocktail to enjoy with the ocean view. This is a quiet, easy trophy — just walk up to the bar, buy the drink, and let the moment play out. It is a good one to grab early while you are exploring the beachfront.

Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car into a vehicle showroom and smash your way back out through the glass in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom with a big front window, drive in through it, then floor it and burst back out onto the street. The trophy pops once you have made your dramatic exit — the police response afterwards is optional.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the bowling alley run by Kolt & Associates and play a game of bowling. The follow-through is the key: line up your shot, pick your angle and power, and release cleanly. You do not need a perfect game — just play through a full game at this specific alley and the trophy pops.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This one is tied to a partnership moment in the game, so keep playing the story and the side content that builds your duo's reputation. The exact trigger is a story beat about your partnership gaining mass appeal, so it should unlock naturally as you progress. If it has not popped by the late game, check which partnership activities you still have open.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make a significant choice at one of the game's decision points and see it through. GTA VI offers moments where your actions shape the outcome, so when a choice appears, pick a side and follow it to its conclusion. The trophy pops once the consequences of that choice have played out.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: This trophy is about a second attempt succeeding where the first one failed, so it unlocks when you retry something and pull it off the second time. Keep playing normally — a failed mission, race or activity that you then complete on the next try is the natural trigger. Do not force it; it comes up on its own during a normal playthrough.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Something strange happens in Leonida, and this trophy is for witnessing it. Keep an eye out for the odd and unexplained while you explore — the swamps and the quiet corners of the map are the usual places for this kind of surprise. When the event triggers, the trophy pops, so explore thoroughly and expect the unexpected.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Perform a melee drive-by that bowls over your target — hit someone with a melee weapon while driving past them. Get a car up to speed on a quiet street, line up a pedestrian or enemy, and swing as you pass. It takes a bit of timing, so practice the approach at low speed first, then go for the real thing.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts will clean them for a cut — keep feeding bills through them over the course of the game. The total adds up across the whole playthrough, so keep robbing and keep laundering until the $250,000 mark is reached.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, car mods, food and anything else that takes cash. This adds up naturally over a full playthrough, but you can speed it up late in the game by buying expensive cars and weapon upgrades. The total is cumulative across every shop, so just keep spending as you go.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property available in Leonida. Garages are sold through the property listings on your phone or through for-sale signs at the properties themselves, and each one costs a chunk of cash — so save up through the story and the robbery trophies first. Once the last garage is yours, the trophy pops.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone, find a vehicle you own or have just acquired, and register it through the app's menu. Repeat with 10 different vehicles — cheap cars and bikes you pick up around Vice City count, so grab a variety and register each one as you go.

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

notes.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and block saving once used, so finish the whole trophy hunt before you ever touch a cheat code.
notes.missable: Only one trophy is possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude (id 28) — meditate at every spot, because the Chapter 1 balcony spot disappears after the chapter ends. No mission replay is reported, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.
notes.online: There are no online trophies in this list — all 55 trophies are single-player and offline, so no PlayStation Plus or multiplayer is needed.
notes.sources_note: Trophy names and descriptions are the official list as published by PlayStation, reported 18 Nov 2026 from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements; the guide text on each trophy is this entry's own words.
notes.time: The platinum takes around 200 hours in total, while the story alone takes around 60 hours — most of the extra time is collectibles, activities and the money grinds.

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.text: Run through all four chapters and the final mission, grabbing the story trophies as they come. Meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot before the chapter ends, and make a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the finale.

roadmap.title: Strangers and side strands
roadmap.text: Clear the side-mission strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, and finish eight stranger strands in total. Answer every call and text, and check the map for question-mark markers in each region.

roadmap.title: Activities and challenges
roadmap.text: Try every activity once, then work the longer grinds: 250 stunts, 20 different race wins, drone races at every location, gold medals at the shooting range, 50 challenges, and the fishing, arcade, bowling and Scooter Bros activities.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and the world
roadmap.text: Hunt the collectible card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles, meditate at every spot, and explore all of Leonida until the map is fully revealed.

roadmap.title: Robberies and the heat
roadmap.text: Work the robbery trophies: shop chains with your partner, the jewelry store stealth job, armored trucks, bank vaults, gang operations, Combat Focus takedowns and losing a 4-star wanted level together.

roadmap.title: Money
roadmap.text: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, spend $100,000 across the shops, and buy every garage property. These add up through normal play, so top them up late in the game with big purchases.

roadmap.title: Cleanup and platinum
roadmap.text: Sweep up the miscellaneous trophies — the airport departure, the Rhino, the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom smash, the choice and event trophies — then check the stats screen for 100% completion and watch the platinum pop.
